warnings: Axes: x = grids 1, 2, 3 at 2.60 + 2.60 (5.20); y = rows A (top) and B printed top-to-bottom, A-B 2.80. Origin A1 (top-left). Scanned สพฐ. set; every sheet is stored rotated in the PDF (read upright).
S-01, S-02 and S-03 all print the same outer x chain 1.20 / 2.60 / 2.60 / 1.20 (+ 5.20 total) - three sheets agree; each sheet's row is kept in dimension_chains.
S-02 adds an x chain 1.30 x 4 (grids 1-1''-2-2'-3): 1'' (1.30) and 2' (3.90) are the B1 beam lines between the toilet cubicles.

A''''' (1.80 below A) is the B2 beam line. S-02 prints 1.00 from it down to row B on its right-hand side, but its ticks sit on the edges of the side 'wing' boxes, so the 1.00 was cross-checked on A-03 (แปลนพื้นห้องน้ำ), where its lower extension line lands on grid B - taken as B minus 1.00 = 1.80 from A. The B4 elevation on S-06 independently prints its first span as 1.80, which agrees.

A'''' (-0.875) is the end of the two short north stubs (B4 at grid 2 carrying the cantilever slab S3, and B3-1 at grid 3). Its position comes from the B4 elevation on S-06, which prints the cantilever as 0.875 from the support dot on grid A. S-02 prints both stubs as 0.80, but the lower tick of each 0.80 sits on the outer face of the row-A beam B5, not on grid A (checked on a 260-dpi crop) - so 0.80 is face-to-end, and 0.80 + ~0.075 half beam = 0.875 is the same point. No separate line at -0.80 was created; both 0.80 prints are kept in unassigned_dimensions.
S-02's 0.50 (x) runs from the west edge of slab S3 to grid 2 (the S3 section on S-05 prints the same 0.50 from the beam centre line) -> 1''' at 2.10.
S-02's 0.30 at the bottom-left measures the side wing box from its outer edge to the outer face of beam B3 - it touches no grid line, so it makes no line (kept in unassigned_dimensions).
S-03 (roof framing) prints a y chain 2.00 / 2.80 / 2.00 to the roof edge (A', B''') and an inner chain 1.00 above A and below B (A''', B') where the steel braces end.
Sweep scope (op04): every structural sheet (S-01..S-06) was swept; of the architectural sheets only A-03 was consulted, for the single 1.00 tick above. Architectural/sanitary sheets were not swept.
No ±0.00 datum is printed on the structural sheets; S-04 measures the footings down from ระดับดินเดิม, which has no printed value - recorded with level_m null.
